checks.check: report file exists and is non-empty
checks.requirement: The report file must exist at exactly: /home/user/package_audit_report.txt

checks.note: keyword at line start, any decoration

checks.check: all non-directory files of dpkg -L nginx listed; file set equals nginx or nginx+nginx-common; no foreign paths
checks.requirement: A categorized list of all files installed by the nginx package
checks.note: live dpkg -L on grader; both readings of 'nginx package' accepted; symlinks optional

checks.check: nginx binary under Binaries, doc/man under Documentation
every direct dependency with its exact version requirement
checks.requirement: All direct dependencies of the nginx package; Version requirements for each dependency
List any postinst (post-installation) scripts associated with nginx
Provide a brief summary of what these scripts do

checks.check: conffiles set equals dpkg conffiles of nginx (empty) or of nginx+nginx-common
checks.requirement: A list of configuration files managed by dpkg ... marked as conffiles
List any systemd service units associated with nginx
Include the service status if possible
checks.note: lenient; 'not available' statements accepted when they contain 'status'
